summary.name: Dressrious
summary.one_liner: An AI-powered fashion app for organizing your wardrobe, planning outfits, tracking clothing expenses, and sharing style content.
use_cases: get outfit ideas based on weather
collect fashion inspiration in mood boards
summary.what_it_does: Dressrious is an all-in-one fashion platform aimed at stylists, influencers and fashion enthusiasts. Users photograph garments and the AI removes backgrounds and automatically categorizes clothes, shoes and accessories. It suggests outfits based on weather, occasion and color harmony, and offers an outfit builder and AI advisor. Other features include an OOTD planner and diary, lookbook and mood boards, wish list, expense tracking (Wardrobe Ledger), a travel planner, laundry scheduling, a fashion community, and a hub for bookmarking online stores. The page lists release notes for versions 2.61 to 2.65, mainly covering iOS 27 support and seasonal outfit logic.
notable: AI background removal for garment photos
weather-based outfit suggestions using Apple Weather data
Wardrobe Ledger expense tracking for clothing
Recent release notes focus on iOS 27 support
caveats: Background removal on iOS 16 relies on third-party packages
Platform support beyond iOS is not stated on the page
